item.text:
**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective. We should prepare now to put that power to work for the public.

2. Better public services, stronger decisions, more capable institutions: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective. We’re ready to help shape that future.

3. We believe in government’s ability to meet big challenges. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective—and we should get ready to use it well.

**(b) Newsletter opening (106 words)**

We are entering a period when powerful new tools could reshape how public institutions serve people. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective. That means stronger capacity to understand complex problems, deliver services, and respond to public needs. The opportunity is not limited to one agency or one country: every government can become more capable. We should start preparing now—building the knowledge, institutions, and public-minded leadership needed to put this technology to work. We are confident in what effective government can accomplish, and we are committed to helping make the most of the transformation ahead.
